description: This PHP source file defines the class ElasticSearchIndexer, which manages creating, updating, and deleting Elasticsearch indices for a SuiteCRM implementation. It includes methods for index management, batch processing, indexing individual beans, and retrieving metadata, as well as configuration and utility functions related to Elasticsearch integration.

classes.name: ElasticSearchIndexer
classes.description: A class responsible for managing Elasticsearch index creation, updates, deletion, and batch indexing of CRM data. Implements differential and full index operations, error handling, metadata management, and configuration for Elasticsearch integration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Starts the indexing procedure, either full or differential, including index setup and module processing.

methods.name: removeIndex
methods.description: Deletes an Elasticsearch index by name.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Creates a new Elasticsearch index with optional settings and mappings.

methods.name: indexModule
methods.description: Executes indexing for a specific module, retrieving data and updating Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: indexBeans
methods.description: Indexes a batch of CRM beans to Elasticsearch and logs the result.

methods.name: indexBean
methods.description: Indexes a single CRM bean to Elasticsearch.

methods.name: removeBean
methods.description: Removes a single CRM bean from Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: removeBeans
methods.description: Removes multiple CRM beans from Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks connectivity with the Elasticsearch server.

methods.name: putMeta
methods.description: Stores metadata information for a specific index.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information for a specific index.

methods.name: getBatchSize
methods.description: Returns the current batch size for index operations.

methods.name: setBatchSize
methods.description: Sets the batch size for index operations.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the configured index name.

methods.name: setIndex
methods.description: Sets the name of the Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: indexBatch
methods.description: Creates a batch request to index or delete multiple beans.

methods.name: differentialIndexing
methods.description: Checks whether differential indexing is enabled.

methods.name: makeIndexParamsBodyFromBean
methods.description: Converts a bean into a document suitable for Elasticsearch indexing.

methods.name: sendBatch
methods.description: Sends a batch of index/delete requests to Elasticsearch and handles errors.

methods.name: makeIndexParamsFromBean
methods.description: Creates an index request payload for a bean.

methods.name: makeParamsHeaderFromBean
methods.description: Creates the request header for a bean-related Elasticsearch operation.

methods.name: getModuleLastIndexed
methods.description: Fetches the last index timestamp for a module from metadata.

methods.name: repairElasticsearchIndex
methods.description: Static method to repair or rebuild the Elasticsearch index, optionally for specific search definitions.
